title: H438 — OpenBB Platform as unified data abstraction layer
rationale: OpenBB Platform v4.5 (May 2026, 51k+ GitHub stars) provides a single API over 100+ data providers. Writing against OpenBB's schema rather than individual providers means yfinance breakages, IEX Cloud shutdowns, and Polygon tier changes can be handled by swapping a provider argument rather than rewriting data pipelines. Free, open-source, has MCP server support for Claude Code integration. IEX Cloud shut down retail API in 2025; yfinance is effectively deprecated after Feb 2025 Yahoo redesign. OpenBB is the correct long-term foundation.
content: Wiki update already applied (2026-07-24 expansion). Next step when medium-risk migration is approved: install openbb + openbb-tiingo in venv and update run_hNNN.py scripts to use obb.equity.price.historical instead of yf.download.
notes: wiki_update already written; medium-risk script migration is a separate proposal requiring Kevin review
